title: 'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun (2/2)
summaryZh: 介紹英文慣用語「不讓腳下長草」，用來形容一個人總是很積極、閒不下來。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: he gave a two-hour-long acceptance speech.
sentences.zh: 他發表了長達兩小時的得獎感言。

sentences.text: Now, grass grows on the ground all the time.
sentences.zh: 草在地上無時無刻都在生長。

sentences.text: And usually, we don't give it much thought.
sentences.zh: 而我們通常不會太去注意它。

sentences.text: For people who are always active, always moving,
sentences.zh: 對於那些總是很有活力、不停在動的人，

sentences.text: always on the go, we can say they don't let grass grow under their feet.
sentences.zh: 也就是老是在跑來跑去的人，我們可以說他們「不讓草長在腳下」。

sentences.text: We can also say beneath their feet.
sentences.zh: 我們也可以說 beneath their feet。

sentences.text: And sometimes, we use this expression as a command.
sentences.zh: 有時候我們還會把這個說法拿來當命令句用。

sentences.text: Don't let the grass grow beneath your feet.
She certainly doesn't let the grass grow under her feet.
sentences.zh: 她絕對是個閒不下來的人。

sentences.text: She's been traveling non-stop for over a year.
sentences.zh: 她已經連續旅行一年多沒停過。

sentences.text: And that's all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 本集〈詞語背後的故事〉的時間就到這裡。

sentences.text: Until next time, I'm Ana Mateo.
